messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick heads-up — updated benefits selection window and exceptions flow for Q2 open enrollment. Please read and action by EOD Friday. TL;DR: 1) Opt-out/change window extended to 14 days, 2) Managers must approve exceptions via the new Jira form, 3) Local benefits exceptions (UK/EU) go through People Ops + Legal. Details: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/benefits-q2-exceptions

Marco Liu: ack, will review with Eng managers tomorrow :thumbsup:

Jenna O'Neil: Aisha — for contractors and fixed-term hires, do they get the same opt-out window? we had questions last cycle.

Aisha Patel: short answer: no — contractors get a 7-day window. Contractor exceptions still routed to People Ops. See table I pasted in the tracker. Tracker: https://docs.redwood.com/sheets/benefits-exception-tracker (please add rows under your team)

Samir Gupta: Also, what about employees on the global mobility program? relocation teams?

Aisha Patel: good catch — Global Mobility folks use the "Relocation/International" queue; Legal signoff required. I'll paste the escalation matrix below.

people-bot: Reminder: compliance training "Benefits & Policy 2025" assigned to Aisha Patel, Jenna O'Neil, Marco Liu. Due 2025-06-06.

Aisha Patel: Escalation matrix (copy/paste for managers): 
```
if local exception -> People Ops (people-ops@redwood.com)
if cross-border or legal impact -> Legal + People Ops
if manager denies but employee appeals -> Compensation Review Panel -> final decision within 10 business days
```

Jenna O'Neil: thanks. I'll add my team rows. Do we want managers to cc People Ops on approvals?

Samir Gupta: +1 on cc People Ops

Aisha Patel: Yes please cc people-ops. For audit we need the Jira ticket link or the sheet row, not both. If you add a Jira ticket, paste the ticket ID in column D of the tracker.

people-ops-bot: Updated tracker: 12 new rows added (teams: eng-runtime, eng-platform, product). Link: https://docs.redwood.com/sheets/benefits-exception-tracker#gid=0

Marco Liu: sending out manager reminder now. @Jenna O'Neil — can you do a quick walk-through with Eng managers at 10am tomorrow?

Jenna O'Neil: can do. Calendar invite sent. thanks.

Aisha Patel: Thanks all. Ping me if any cross-border edge cases. :raised_hands:
